about_the_game:
Catgirls DO PORN: DEMO gives you the first 5 levels to play, break, and unlock. Just enough to show the loop, the style, and the kind of rewards you can expect.

🐱 What’s inside

  • Classic block-breaker gameplay

  • 5 unlockable catgirl scenes to check the quality

  • Fast loops, instant restarts, no fluff

It’s a teaser — a glimpse at the rhythm and rewards that scale all the way up to 100+ scenes in the full game. If you enjoy these first steps, you’ll know exactly what to expect next.
